//: Copy to mootify.json and fill in. mootify.json is gitignored — never commit the API key.

Lidarr.//: ApiKey also reads from the Lidarr__ApiKey environment variable or a Docker secret.
Lidarr.//QualityProfileId: Pick one WITHOUT FLAC. Lidarr's stock 'Standard' profile is usually id 3.
Lidarr.//MaxSearchesPerPass: Albums one poll may re-ask Lidarr to search for. The brake is your indexers' rate limits, not Lidarr. Passes work the backlog oldest-first, so a lower number is slower rather than incomplete.

MusicBrainz.//Contact: MusicBrainz requires an identifying User-Agent with contact info; put a real address or repo here.

Library.//MusicRoot: The path THIS app can see. Lidarr's root folder is a path inside its own container, so it is usually a different string. A UNC share works: \\\\host\\Data\\MediaMusic
Library.//Username: Only needed for a UNC share that requires a login. Windows only — on Linux, mount the share in the OS.
Library.//Password: Also reads from the Library__Password environment variable or a Docker secret.
Library.//ImportFolder: A drop folder inside MusicRoot. Everything left in it is filed under Artist/Album before each scan, and it is never itself indexed. Blank turns it off.
Library.//UnsortedFolder: Where a file whose artist can't be worked out lands. It stays in the library so somebody can find it and tag it.

Requests.//MaxOpenPerUser: The starting quota. An admin can change it at /admin, and that number then wins over this one until they clear it.

Api.//: The token-authenticated API the Android app uses. There is nothing to enable — it authenticates the same accounts the website does.
Api.//TokenLifetime: How long a signed-in phone stays signed in. 0 means never expires. A car stereo asking for a password is worse than useless; devices are revoked from /account.
Api.//ArtCacheDirectory: Extracted cover art. Empty means data/art-cache — never put it inside MusicRoot, which the scanner walks.
